item.title: Akhil Gogoi Questions Zubeen Garg Death Probe, Alleges Evidence and Names Missing

Gogoi alleged that critical evidence and key individuals were omitted or inadequately represented in the investigation. item.title: iFOREST, APCB Launch Guwahati’s First Hotspot-Based Clean Air Action Plan to Curb Pollution
item.description: In a significant step to tackle worsening air pollution, iFOREST, in partnership with the Assam Pollution Control Board (APCB), on Tuesday launched Guwahati’s first comprehensive hotspot-based Clean Air Action Plan, built on detailed ward-level pollution mapping. Guwahati has been battling chronic air pollution since 2017, with particulate matter levels frequently breaching national standards. item.title: Supreme Court Clears Action Against Overaged Diesel and Petrol Vehicles Below BS-IV in Delhi NCR
item.description: In a significant clarification, the Supreme Court on Wednesday (December 17) modified its August 12 order and ruled that coercive action can be taken against diesel vehicles older than 10 years and petrol vehicles older than 15 years in the National Capital Region if they fail to meet BS-IV emission standards. item.description: The Chhattisgarh Assembly witnessed major disruption on the fourth day of its winter session as all Congress MLAs entered the House carrying placards reading ‘Satyamev Jayate’, protesting the Enforcement Directorate’s actions against Sonia Gandhi and Rahul Gandhi in the National Herald case. item.title: Assam CM Hands Rs 5 Lakh Aid to Families of Assam Labourers Killed in Arunachal Crash
item.description: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma met the families of labourers who lost their lives in a tragic road mishap in Arunachal Pradesh and announced financial assistance to help them cope with the loss. The Chief Minister handed over an ex gratia amount of Rs 5 lakh each to the next of kin of 21 workers from Assam who were killed when a truck plunged into a deep gorge in Arunachal Pradesh’s Anjaw district. item.title: Fugitive Mehul Choksi Loses Final Legal Battle in Belgium, Extradition Cleared
item.description: Belgium’s highest court has dealt a decisive blow to fugitive diamond merchant Mehul Choksi’s last-ditch effort to avoid being sent back to India, rejecting his appeal and clearing the way for his extradition in the multi-crore Punjab National Bank fraud case. item.title: Guwahati: Vehicle Fire Causes Major Traffic Jam on Saraighat Bridge
item.description: A van engaged in distributing mid-day meals to schools caught fire on the National Highway near the old Saraighat Bridge in Guwahati ‘s Jalukbari on Thursday morning, triggering panic among commuters and also causing massive traffic congestion in the area. Fire tenders rushed to the spot soon after the incident and launched firefighting operations to bring the blaze under control. item.title: How 2025 became another deadliest year for scribes
item.description: As the year 2025 approaches the end, it has already emerged as a deadliest year for journalists since the beginning of the century, after 2024. At least 161 media professionals were killed in 31 countries till date this year, where 2024 witnessed 179 journo-casualties around the world. item.description: An 11-year-old student has taken the legal battle over admissions in Delhi’s CM SHRI Schools to the next level, approaching a Division Bench of the Delhi High Court to challenge the government’s policy of holding an entrance test for admission to Class VI.
